Headers standardized by SSDC on 2026-06-26T22:53:35.819 (UTC)

limitations: Original oversampled EPSF response, not a physical depth or total-source aperture correction.
No deconvolution, PSF matching or error covariance inferred.
Native cutout sample, not a population catalogue.
Standardized excursions are not source detections, artifact identifications or a multiple-trial-corrected significance.

statistics.data: original calibrated IMAGE; no zodiacal subtraction

surface.height_meaning: Calibrated surface brightness, not physical astronomical distance
surface.processing: Arithmetic block mean of science-usable original pixels; no interpolation or normalization
surface.measurement_warning: Derived visualization grid; use original FITS for quantitative analysis.

quality.variance_interpretation: sqrt of per-pixel calibrated VARIANCE; not empirical sky noise or artifact classification
quality.source_flag_interpretation: Known catalog source membership; neither a detection count nor an independent quality approval

centroids.method: Bounded elliptical Gaussian plus constant background, variance-weighted fit; formal covariance
limitations: No instrument EPSF matching or deblending; crowded/multiple peaks can invalidate a single-Gaussian centroid.
Formal covariance excludes absolute astrometric/calibration systematics.
Measurements are independently centered near the selected position; association is not established merely by window overlap.
